checks.claim: cut the hourly rate advanced-reactor applicants pay for review from $318 to $148 (it is $154 under the FY2026 fee rule)
checks.evidence: The FY2026 final fee rule (Federal Register, 2026-06-16) sets the Reduced Hourly Rate at $154 per hour, up from $148. It also raises the full professional hourly rate to $337 for FY2026, from $318. The $154 figure is current; the $318 full-rate baseline is the FY2025 figure, not the FY2026 one.
